quick_warnings: Never hail street taxis — always use Uber, InDriver, or authorized airport taxis with a fixed fare.
Altitude is 2,240 m (7,350 ft). Allow 1–2 days to acclimatize before intense activity.
Metro pickpockets are common — keep phones and wallets out of sight, especially during rush hour.

detail_guide.getting_around: The Metro (MXN ~6/ride) is fast, cheap, and covers the entire city. Use Uber or InDriver for door-to-door trips. Avoid street taxis entirely. Ecobici bike-share is excellent in Roma, Condesa, and Polanco.
